refundPolicy: No automatic refunds. Access exists only after the payment protocol reports a successful settlement. That access is an entitlement for one resource and one release, held by a capability token. If delivery fails after settlement, the buyer can recover in two ways: re-download with the capability token until it expires (30 days, at most 20 downloads), or ask for operator review using the purchase id or settlement transaction. A protocol receipt (x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE or MPP Payment-Receipt) proves that a payment happened. It does not grant access by itself and it is never accepted as a credential. An operator may refund manually after review. Refunds are not automatic.
